description: Non-material amendment to 21/02517/FUL to allow amendment to the description of works to read as follows: Demolition of existing two-storey Train Drivers Accommodation building and erection of four buildings, with part basement area, recessed rooftop plant and lift overruns located behind a parapet and screens, and comprising new residential dwelling units (Class C3) with flexible retail ground floor unit (Class E and/or drinking establishment (Sui Generis) uses), replacement Train Drivers Accommodation (Sui Generis), cycle parking, public realm and open space, car parking, hard and soft landscaping, access and servicing, plant and associated works.

decision_conditions: New Condition 41: The development hereby approved shall comprise 351 residential units (Class C3).Reason: To ensure the development is in accordance with the approved scheme and complies with Policies D6 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies CP4 and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), which seek to secure an appropriate housing mix and density consistent with local character and infrastructure capacity.

New Condition 42: The height of the buildings hereby approved shall range between 5 and 14 storeys above ground level.Reason: To ensure the development is in accordance with the approved scheme and to protect the character and appearance of the area, including the Trent Park Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies D6 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies CP30 and CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010).
